text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I watch the Takarazuka Kinen with Satono Diamond. Kitasan Black runs rather poorly and suffers a defeat. The crowd is baffled by her irregular performance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Kitasan Black must have pushed herself too hard in her training after the exhausting spring Tenno Sho and worn herself out.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Kitasan Black is distraught from having disappointed everyone, but Satono Diamond gently comforts her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: When the fans watch Kitasan Black trying her best, they see themselves in her and want to cheer her on. They almost certainly don't want to see her give up.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Not only that, but Satono Diamond is hoping the same. With that said, she leaves Kitasan Black to find the answers for herself.
